answer: The milkmaid washes the rind with ale to ripen the cheese gold, setting the washed wheels back on the shelf, and the work is better for it. Shelf butter cream potter curd writ is the washing here: a writ butter cream potters sign after potting shed audits. The dawn begins the washing on the ale, the timber finishes the washing, the trellis proves the rind. Forging the proof needs 79 false ales and 79 false washings.
